verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a hosted MCP server that gives AI assistants direct access to project data. Through it an agent can query events, funnels, flows and retention in natural language, and a probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. The Query API independently returns the same calculated report results seen in the web app, and agent-oriented OpenAPI specs are published. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents reliably answer growth questions via the MCP server or Query API.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent answer growth questions from live product data by running queries through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Mixpanel provides a hosted Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that gives AI assistants direct access to your Mixpanel data.
Once connected, you can query events, funnels, flows, retention, session replays, and more using natural language — no dashboard navigation required.
The Query API allows you to obtain the same calculated and formatted results that you see from a report in our web app.
